scope: Archive 010, the terse catalogue entries for the same key items archive 009 describes. Identical in both revisions.
provenance: Claude translator-authored Japanese to Korean, 2026-09-20; no independent review yet
tone: The source writes this list in clipped all-katakana with no sentence endings, a catalogue voice rather than Rockman's. Korean carries that with noun endings and 〜음/〜함 instead of the 〜야/〜네 archive 009 uses.
notes: The source has two typos this keeps meaning-faithful rather than copying: ボミすてば for ゴミすてば, and ネピュラ for ネビュラ.

revisions: 2026-09-27: area numbers join their name (에리어3), as the Japanese writes エリア3 and as 86 lines already did; this batch had the spaced form.

2026-09-28: the memo and hint data riddles, deferred since this batch was written because their answers were not established, are resolved. The memo reads backwards line by line: びなのりどみ／んさありえんうた is みどりのなび たうんえりあさん, a green navi in Town Area 3. The hint data reads as a spiral, as its next line うずまき says, clockwise from the top-right corner and down first: がしてみるは／さ!なだんな／をかなのばた is はなたばのなかをさがしてみるんだな!. Both answers use every letter of the source. The Korean is scrambled the same way: 비내 록초／3어리에 운타 reads backwards as 초록 내비 타운 에리어3, and 보는거꽃／아!야다／찾을속발 reads by the same spiral as 꽃다발속을찾아보는거야!. The story gate now holds these and the kidnapper riddle to their readings.
